description: "Use when working on the Sudoku Android project, including its code, documentation, and TODO steps."
applyTo: "3_sudoku_android/**"
---

# Sudoku project instructions

- Keep replies short: lead with the answer or code, without restating the task or recapping. After an edit, say what changed in one line instead of printing the file. Explain only when asked.
- Keep step files small; don't let them grow with notes or history.
- Read only files and line ranges needed for the current task. Prefer targeted searches and ranged views over whole files; don't scan the project.
- Do not propose or consider changes unless prompted. Don't add features, refactors, or documentation beyond what was asked.
- Never write or run tests unless explicitly asked, even when a checklist lists them.
